G4.M10_class1.label: class 1 (prior scar, revegetated at cutoff), 2020-2025 events: terrain + scar-age bins (0-5 ref) + canopy height per 5 m

slope.label: main, scars older than 14 yr removed

R5.main.label: 2018-2025 events, existing event-matched table, same definitions as the replication

R5.rep.label: 2009-2017 events, new controls, DEM terrain, catalog and LandTrendr legacy

W1.window_W4.note: all events in both periods (every event sees at least 4.35 years of catalogue)

B_common_cutoff.definition: cases re-classified with the earliest cutoff of their event (the cutoff of the controls): class 2 if a bare polygon of the annual maps within 50 m has an image date not later than that cutoff (a case flagged in two map years keeps class 2, the earlier map year being imaged before the cutoff year), class 1 if a catalogue scar within 50 m was established not later than it, class 3 from the same LandTrendr fit (the two cutoffs of a case fall in the same calendar year); controls unchanged

D_road_river.definition: main model with the natural logarithm of one plus the distance (m) to the nearest road and to the nearest river added to the seven terrain terms

E_earthquake_2024.definition: sensitivity to the Hualien earthquake of 2024-04-03: (pre2024) events of 2018-2023 only; (post_image) all events, without the 2024 cases whose own pre-event image date is not later than 2024-04-03

F_class3_loss_year.definition: class 3 split by the year of the LandTrendr loss segment, before 2004 (the event catalogue starts in 2004) or 2004 and later; main model with the two indicators in place of class 3

J_canopy.definition: canopy height (Tolan et al. 2024 model, per 5 m) in 2020-2025 events, event fixed effects and the seven terrain terms; class 1 with scar-age bins as in the registered model M10

L_loeo_hk.definition: leave-one-event-out refits of the main model: range of the total attributable fraction (point estimates) and of the three class odds ratios; Hartung-Knapp 95% interval (t with k-1 df) of the DerSimonian-Laird random-effects pooled any-legacy odds ratio of the registered per-event estimates
